summary: Verified R14 GitHub connect state-dropped-on-reconnect root-cause fix. Ran targeted pytest for both new test files (test_r14_github_state_dropped_reconnect_2026_09.py: 9/9 pass; test_iter2026_08_27_github_connect_state_recovery.py: 7/7 pass — 16/16 total). Ran regression pass on adjacent github_app router/service/project_add tests (62 pass, 2 fail — both confirmed PRE-EXISTING by git-stash bisection, not regressions from R14). Curl-verified live behavior on preview URL: (a) POST /api/aurem-dev/github/app/claim without auth -> 401; (b) with malformed body -> 422; (c) GET /callback with missing state param + non-existent installation_id -> 302 soft-redirect to installed?status=err&err=invalid_state (correct — no orphan created, no hard fail).
